toolCommands: /bin/zsh -lc "node corpus-tool.mjs anx search 'Compare the number of LEAs surveyed, responses recorded, and stated response rates in the 2023-24 and 2024-25 Transitional Kindergarten reports.' 12"
/bin/zsh -lc "node corpus-tool.mjs anx search-document 'doc-007' 'response rate LEAs surveyed responses recorded 2023-24' 12"
/bin/zsh -lc "node corpus-tool.mjs anx search-document 'doc-008' 'response rate LEAs surveyed responses recorded 2024-25' 12"

parsed.answer: 2023-24: 2,208 LEAs were surveyed and 1,579 responses were recorded—about 72% of all surveyed LEAs. After excluding 385 LEAs that said they did not offer TK, the report states 1,579 responses out of 1,823 remaining LEAs, or 87%. 2024-25: 1,464 LEAs were surveyed and 952 responses were recorded—about 65%. After 26 LEAs reported no TK program, 926 of the remaining LEAs (95%) indicated they had at least one TK program; this 95% figure is program-status participation, not a stated response rate. Thus, the 2024-25 survey covered 744 fewer LEAs, recorded 627 fewer responses, and had a stated overall rate 7 percentage points lower than 2023-24.
